name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
summary: Kum'isha accepts Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and gives a reward for each one. You bring him the fragments, though his regard for them is plain.

sections.title: Kum'isha's Offer
sections.body: Kum'isha offers you a reward for each Imperfect Draenethyst Fragment you bring him. His words make clear what he thinks of the fragments and of anyone who brings them.

faq.q: What do I get for a fragment?
faq.answer: Kum'isha gives you a reward for each Imperfect Draenethyst Fragment you bring him.

faq.q: What does Kum'isha think of the fragments?

attribution: In-game quest text: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
